subject: Preprod burst credit (escrow) request for Lakeside POC
messages:
From: Kai Chen <kai.chen@lakeside.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Preprod burst credit for our POC — 4/20 stress window

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency stability. We have a scheduled preprod stress window next Tuesday (2027-04-20 03:00-07:00 UTC) to validate throughput and tail latency for our integration.

Can Redwood provision a short-term, escrowed credit allocation we can draw down during the run? Rough estimate: 200k tokens over a 4-hour window with occasional 2k-token spikes for longer sequences. We want the traffic to come from our IPs in the test cluster and keep results isolated.

If possible, please outline any constraints (rate caps, per-minute QPS limits) and what you need from us to enable the test.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — this run is a gating item for our internal sign-off.

Best,
Kai
Principal SRE, Lakeside AI
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Chen <kai.chen@lakeside.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preprod burst credit for our POC — 4/20 stress window

Hi Kai — thanks for the details and the heads up. We can support an escrowed trial top-up for the test window. A few quick asks so we size the buffer and set appropriate caps:

- Expected sustained RPS and peak QPS (rough numbers or histogram if available)
- Typical input token length distribution and the 95th pct token length you might hit
- Exact UTC window you will run (you mentioned 03:00-07:00 UTC — confirm)
- IPs and any VPC peering details for routing, plus whether you want request logging retained after the test

Marissa — can you propose an internal configuration (batching/quantization profile) and a recommended token buffer? Rishi — I may need a short note for the promotional credit approval.

I can start the paperwork for an escrowed credit that only the Lakeside account can draw during the window; we typically create a time-limited allocation with a per-minute QPS ceiling.

Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Chen <kai.chen@lakeside.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preprod burst credit for our POC — 4/20 stress window

Kai / Olga — copied the test plan snippet below and attaching a short runbook.

Summary (quick):
- Target sustained throughput: 150 RPS
- Short peaks: up to 420 RPS for ~15s bursts
- Typical prompt tokens: 40–120, 95th percentile ~800 tokens on long documents
- Expected total token draw: ~210k tokens over 4 hours (includes KB lookups + chat history)
- KV cache warm-up: ~20 minutes at low QPS to reach steady-state cache hit rates

Recommendation: provision an escrowed allocation of 275k tokens to cover spikes and retries, with a soft per-minute QPS cap of 500 and a hard cap of 700 to protect shared nodes. We'll configure intelligent batching and enable prefix caching for the run.

Attachments: Lakeside_SRE_runbook.pdf (run steps, IP whitelist, log sample).

If you confirm the numbers and the window, Olga — please route this to Finance for a short promotional credit approval and put the allocation into an escrow that auto-releases unused tokens back to Redwood after 48 hours.

Grace — requesting a one-off promotional credit allocation: 275k token escrow for Lakeside AI (deal LS-POC-2027-08). The account will only be able to consume during a narrow test window (2027-04-20 03:00-07:00 UTC) and we will enforce a soft cap of 500 QPS / hard cap 700 QPS. Remaining tokens auto-return 48h after window.

Why: The customer must validate tail-latency at scale prior to internal sign-off. This directly influences conversion to Dedicated/Reserved capacity.

Risk controls: IP whitelist, rate caps, retention off by default for this run (logs retained for 7 days), and ops on-call assigned. Attached is the SRE runbook for the execution steps.

Approval requested: Please confirm fund/credit approval and whether we need an internal promo-code or a finance-backed escrow.

Thanks,
Olga
